# Legal Writing Institute (LWI)

> The Legal Writing Institute is the premier professional organization for legal writing educators, offering conferences, publications, awards, and advocacy resources for the legal writing community.

LWI serves as the central hub for legal writing professionals, providing networking opportunities, professional development, and scholarly resources. The organization advocates for legal writing faculty and maintains active committees addressing professional status, curriculum development, and pedagogical innovation.

## Key Topics

- Legal Writing Institute (LWI)
- Legal writing education
- Biennial Conference
- Professional development
- Board of Directors

## Conferences & Events

- [Conferences of all Types](https://www.lwionline.org/conferences): LWI conferences including Biennial Conference and New Teacher Training Bootcamp.
- [One-Day Workshops](https://www.lwionline.org/one-day-workshops): LWI one-day workshops on legal writing, judicial clerkships, and pedagogy.

## Publications & Resources

- [Articles & Publications](https://www.lwionline.org/articles): LWI publications including journal, monograph series, and Second Draft.
- [Monograph Series](https://www.lwionline.org/publications/monograph-series): LWI Monograph Series on legal writing, communication, and teaching resources.
